paragraphs: Hyman describes him as a student of Rav Nachman, citing Bava Batra 113b, where he recited a teaching before Rav Nachman; Abaye said to him, etc.[^1]

notes.text: The actual Davidson Bava Batra 113b paragraph has Rabbah bar Chanina reciting before Rav Nachman and Abaye replying to him. The local full Rav Nachman expansion is supported; describing Rabbah as his student remains Hyman’s inference, not a newly admitted teacher relationship.
